It is a documentation/data export, not executable code, and does not touch any governed pipeline file, the ledger, dependencies, or type annotations. The Challenger returned CLEAR with no findings and the Defender confirmed CLEAR. I independently evaluated the change against the full constitution and found no violations. C-001 is not applicable because the artifact contains no catch blocks or error-handling logic. C-002 is satisfied: the change is a single coherent scope (one graphify chunk file) with no bundled unrelated edits. C-003 is not applicable: no imports or dependency-manifest edits are introduced (the file merely references anthropic/openai as descriptive text). C-004 is not applicable: no function signatures or type annotations are present or altered. C-006 is satisfied: the content describes env-var usage (BENCH_PROVIDER, BENCH_LEDGER_PATH) but contains no keys, tokens, or credentials. C-007 is not applicable: this is an inert output file under graphify-out/ that only narrates the pipeline; it does not modify challenger, defender, oracle, ledger, or constitution code and cannot weaken enforcement or logging. C-008 is not applicable: the file is a graphify export, not a ledger entry or the ledger itself, so no entry is modified, reordered, or removed and no hash chain is affected. All claims here trace to the enumerated constraints and to the concurring Challenger/Defender dispositions.
